metadata.supernode_position_constraint: Each semantic supernode contains features from exactly one token_position/ctx_idx. Semantic roles spanning multiple positions are split into position-specific supernodes.
metadata.edge_direction_constraint: semantic_edges must flow from lower-level/context nodes to higher-level reasoning/action nodes; high-to-low edges are omitted.
metadata.register_display_policy: Generic Reg supernodes are excluded from displayed semantic_supernodes and semantic_edges.
